chunks: And in the narration of ʿAbd al-Raḥmān ibn Abī ʿAbdillāh, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:

key_terms.الْعَشْرِ: the ten days, referring contextually to the first ten days of Dhū al-Ḥijjah
key_terms.مُتْعَةٌ: tamattuʿ; the form of pilgrimage in which ʿumrah is performed before hajj

ai.seo_question: Is ʿumrah performed during the first ten days considered tamattuʿ?
ai.summary: This hadith states that performing ʿumrah during the first ten days is treated as tamattuʿ. It pertains to the fiqh of hajj and clarifies the legal status of ʿumrah within the months and period associated with hajj.
